verdict.rationale: MX documents free self-serve developer API keys from the Client Dashboard, test institutions for sandbox connections, and a downloadable OpenAPI spec for Postman. Its only first-party SDKs are Web and React Native SDKs for embedding the Connect Widget, not server-side API client libraries. Missing for 10: a documented runnable end-to-end quickstart, official API client libraries across multiple languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-linked-account.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first linked sandbox account fast — self-serve API keys, a runnable quickstart, and client libraries in my language

citations.quote: log in to Client Dashboard and select **API keys** to access your developer API keys. Developer API keys are free.
We offer four test institutions that you can use
You can download our OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman to learn more about our API
